subject.title: Validate required run artifacts against a schema (`--require-artifact-schema`)

question: Should Crabbox core own a new artifact-content schema language and `--require-artifact-schema` CLI contract, or should schema validation remain the responsibility of each repository command?
rationale: Current documentation deliberately limits the built-in gate to existence checks, while the proposal adds a new repeatable flag, validation dialect, size policy, provider restrictions, exit semantics, and timing-report surface that require long-term product ownership.

options.title: Keep validation repository-owned
options.body: Preserve the existing existence-only Crabbox contract and document how repository commands should validate their evidence before exiting successfully.

options.title: Sponsor the core schema gate
options.body: Accept the new core capability, define its permanent compatibility contract, and review the linked pull request after real SSH-backed behavior proof is added.

recommendation.title: Keep validation repository-owned
recommendation.body: Preserve the existing existence-only Crabbox contract and document how repository commands should validate their evidence before exiting successfully.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work on the required-artifact gate makes steipete the strongest available routing candidate for this contract decision.
